text_block_list.text:
Several days have passed since the
spring Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс regrets provoking Super
Creek
with her unsportsmanlike remarks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hearing this, I learn that Тамамо Кросс
had
ignited Супер Крик's fervor by
threatening to
hurt me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I hope that Супер Крик is able to run
her next
race with a calm mind and
peaceful heart.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
